text: 55-year-old woman. The patient reports a 2-month history of insidious onset left shoulder pain, worsening with extreme ranges of motion and activity. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Rotator Cuff Tendinopathy/Partial Tear (likely Supraspinatus) due to chronic overuse/impingement in a 55-year-old diabetic female with night pain and loss of active range of motion.
